verdict.rationale: Credential handling is a fair question for a self-hostable, multi-user AI workspace that takes LLM provider API keys, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a secrets store, env-based separation, or redaction of keys from chat history. The 'API Access & Keys' item is only a page title about the product's own API, and 'bring an LLM API Key' says nothing about how keys are stored or masked.
